title: Kusacutshungulwa — Kusacutshungulwa Kusho Ukuthini Ekuhloleni Isimo Se-SASSA?
description: Isimo sesibonelelo sakho se-SASSA sibonisa 'Kusacutshungulwa' — nakhu okuchazwayo, ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo.

seo.metaTitle: Isimo Se-SASSA Kusacutshungulwa? Kuchaza Ukuthini Nokuthi Kuthatha Isikhathi Esingakanani (2026)
seo.metaDescription: Isimo se-SASSA 'Kusacutshungulwa' ngo-2026? Funda ukuthi kuchaza ukuthini, ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo ngenkathi isicelo sakho sesibonelelo sihlolwa.

contentBlocks.title: Kusacutshungulwa — Kuchaza Ukuthini Ngesibonelelo Sakho
contentBlocks.description: Isimo sakho se-SASSA sibonisa 'Kusacutshungulwa' — isicelo sakho sitholiwe futhi siyahlolwa. Funda ukuthi inqubo yokucutshungulwa ihlanganisa ukuthini, izikhathi ezijwayelekile, nokuthi yini okufanele uyenze nokungafanele uyenze ngenkathi ulinde isinqumo.

contentBlocks.text: Uma isimo sesibonelelo sakho se-SASSA sibonisa 'Kusacutshungulwa', kusho ukuthi isicelo sakho sitholiwe futhi siyahlolwa yizikhulu ze-SASSA. Lokhu kuyingxenye ejwayelekile yenqubo yokufaka isicelo.

contentBlocks.explanation: Isicelo sakho sisemgqeni wokuhlolwa. I-SASSA iqinisekisa imininingwane yakho yomuntu, imininingwane yokuhlolwa kwezimali, namadokhumenti asekelayo ngokuqhathanisa namarekhodi ayo.
whyItHappens: I-SASSA ithola izinkulungwane zezicelo nsuku zonke
Kungase kudingeke ukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe kwamadokhumenti athile
Izibalo zokuhlolwa kwezimali zithatha isikhathi ukucutshungulwa
Ukuhlolwa ngesandla kungase kwenziwe ezimeni eziyinkimbinkimbi
contentBlocks.howLongItLasts: Ngokujwayelekile amasonto angu-4–8 kusukela ngosuku lokuthunyelwa kwesicelo. Izicelo ze-SRD R370 zingase zixazululeke ngokushesha (amasonto angu-1–2).
whatYouShouldDo: Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana isesikhathini

Ungafaki isicelo esiphindwe kabili — lokhu kuzodala ukubambezeleka

items: Ukuthumela isicelo esiphindwe kabili ucabanga ukuthi kuzosheshisa inqubo — lokhu empeleni kubuyisela emuva indawo yakho emgqeni
Ukungabheki iphaneli elifanele lesimo — sebenzisa i-srd.sassa.gov.za ngezibonelelo ze-SRD
Ukungazinaki izicelo ze-SASSA zamadokhumenti engeziwe — hlala uphendula ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinikiwe
Ukushintsha imininingwane yasebhange ngenkathi isicelo sakho sisacutshungulwa — lokhu kungadala ukubambezeleka okusha kokuqinisekiswa

contentBlocks.text: Isimo Sami Asishintshanga Emasontweni — Ingabe Simile?

Isimo esihlala sinjalo isikhathi esithile ngokujwayelekile sisahamba emgqeni wokuhlolwa, asimile. Kwezama-SRD R370, inyanga ngayinye ihlolwa njengomjikelezo wayo, ngakho isimo singahlala singashintshile ingxenye yenyanga bese sishintsha lapho uhlelo olulandelayo lokuhlola lusebenza. Bheka isimo sakho ku-srd.sassa.gov.za kunokuba usebenzise amasayithi ezinkampani zangaphandle, ngoba lawo angabonisa ulwazi oluphelelwe yisikhathi. Uma usuqhubeka unecutshungulwayo isikhathi eside kunomkhawulo ojwayelekile wesibonelelo sakho, bheka umhlahlandlela wethu wezinsuku ezingaphezu kwengu-30, futhi qinisekisa ukuthi isimo sakho asishintshile sithule saya kokuthile okufana ne-'Bank Verification' — lokho kungase kubukeke kungenamsebenzi kodwa empeleni kusho ukuthi i-SASSA ilinde imininingwane yokukhokha ohlangothini lwakho.

faqs.question: Isimo 'Kusacutshungulwa' sihlala isikhathi esingakanani?
faqs.answer: Ngezibonelelo eziningi, kusacutshungulwa kuhlala amasonto angu-4–8. Izicelo ze-SRD R370 ngokujwayelekile zixazululeka phakathi kwamasonto angu-1–2. Uma sekuyisikhathi esingaphezu kwamasonto angu-8, xhumana ne-SASSA.

faqs.question: Ingabe 'Kusacutshungulwa' kusho ukuthi isicelo sami siphuphumele?
faqs.answer: Cha. Kusacutshungulwa kusho kuphela ukuthi isicelo sakho sitholiwe futhi siyahlolwa. Isimo sizoshintsha sibe 'Isemukelwe', 'Sinqatshiwe', noma sesinye isimo uma ukuhlolwa kuqedile.

faqs.question: Ngingasisheshisa yini inqubo yokucutshungulwa?
faqs.answer: Cha, kodwa ungagwema ukubambezeleka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti akho athunyelwe kahle nangokuphendula ngokushesha kuzo zonke izicelo ze-SASSA zolwazi olwengeziwe.

faqs.question: Isimo sami asishintshanga emasontweni — ingabe kukhona okungahambi kahle?
faqs.answer: Ngokujwayelekile akukho. Izicelo zingahlala emgqeni wokuhlolwa amasonto ambalwa ngaphandle kokushintsha okubonakalayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ubheka kuphaneli elisemthethweni, qaphela izimo ezifana ne-'Bank Verification' ezidinga isenzo kuwena, bese uxhumana ne-SASSA kuphela uma usuqhubile ngenkathi ejwayelekile yokucutshungulwa kwezinhlobo zesibonelelo sakho.

faqs.question: Bengingacutshungulwa futhi manje sithi 'Isemukelwe' kodwa akukho usuku lokukhokha. Ngabe lokho kujwayelekile?
faqs.answer: Yebo — ukwemukelwa kuvame ukubonakala ngaphambi kokungezwa kosuku lokukhokha. Bheka umhlahlandlela wethu wokwemukelwa ngaphandle kosuku lokukhokha ukuze ubone okulindelekile ngokulandelayo.
